# Paul Carver Tiffany III

> Independent researcher in operational epistemology, observer-relative geometry, geometric alignment, and auditable AI systems.

## Public gateways

- [The Hypothesis Surface — AGI-26](https://paultiffany.github.io/come-to-AGI-26/): Published paper, poster, guided tour, and public companion materials.
- [Principia Symbolica](https://paultiffany.github.io/Principia-Symbolica/): Main public doorway for the book and its machine-readable resources.
- [Principia Symbolica — searchable HTML atlas](https://paultiffany.github.io/Principia-Symbolica/atlas/): Crawlable projection of all 1,914 structured atlas records, ordered according to the manuscript's `src/main.tex` publication sequence.
- [Principia Symbolica Atlas — canonical JSON](https://paultiffany.github.io/Principia-Symbolica/principia_atlas.json): Authoritative structured mathematical content, source bodies, proof status, citations, labels, and dependency edges.
- [Principia Symbolica Atlas — text fallback](https://paultiffany.github.io/Principia-Symbolica/principia_atlas.txt): Byte-identical plain-text fallback for tools that cannot retrieve JSON directly.
- [Principia Symbolica Atlas — GitHub raw fallback](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PaulTiffany/Principia-Symbolica/main/principia_atlas.json): Secondary transport mirror; the GitHub Pages JSON remains canonical.
- [Principia Symbolica PDF](https://paultiffany.github.io/Principia-Symbolica/main.pdf): Human-readable manuscript.
- [Wicked Geometry](https://paultiffany.github.io/wicked-geometry/): Public manuscript and supporting evidence on atlas fracture and observer-relative geometry.
- [Sketched](https://paultiffany.github.io/sketched/): Local-first witnessed drawing surface.
- [Chalked](https://paultiffany.github.io/chalked/): Permission-gated shared whiteboard and OmegaClaw demonstration.
- [Compitum](https://compitum.space/): Geometrically aware AI router.

## Reading guidance

Humans begin with the Principia Symbolica doorway and book. Search systems and ordinary web tools use the searchable HTML atlas. Machine readers use the GitHub Pages JSON when exact structure, proof status, citation, or dependency information matters, with the text mirror and GitHub raw JSON as transport fallbacks. Use public gateways before consulting repositories. Treat archived research repositories as historical records rather than live editing targets. Preserve distinctions among published results, public demonstrations, formalization work, and exploratory materials.
